items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Tommy, Tommy Guinan, the boss, he's drunk

ctx.x: Tommy, Tommy Guinan, the boss, he's drunk, and messing with this woman, he gets in an argument with the man, and she tells Tommy to shut up, and he hits her in the nose and breaks her nose. Well, this was the first week the club opened up -- the first few days. I think we made two weeks in there, in the club, because that was it. Her daddy put so much weight on for hitting his daughter, and he was a millionaire, too...and just closed the place down. I don't know what happened to Tommy. I don't know if he went to…

All these good jobs... Funny thing, I went from one job right to another. I never had a day off in between. So I don't know if this is the time Willie Lynch come up with this band idea or not. I know I was open, and I took whatever was open to me.
